findings.text: D2 assumes that copying `parser/` into the text package’s Nix workspace is sufficient, but `lean-package.nix` exports only the package directory, so the surface’s separate build lacks the sources that Lake checks when replaying the parser target. Fix: require the parser sources in each Nix workspace that builds or replays the text package.

The trial claims coverage of all retained corpora, but `parserLibrary.inputs` includes only corpora v1–v5, while v6 alone contains 53 additional SQL texts. Fix: describe the recorded 11,118 inputs as parser test inputs and texts from corpora v1–v5.
